name: OneSignal
description: The OneSignal MCP server gives AI agents direct access to OneSignal’s customer engagement platform. Agents can explore users, segments, messages, templates, and analytics; answer product and campaign questions; troubleshoot delivery and engagement issues; generate insights; and help create personalized omnichannel messaging across push, email, SMS, RCS, in-app messaging, and Live Activities.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OneSignal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OneSignal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.onesignal.com/mcp/oauth. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OneSignal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OneSignal lists 29 MCP tools, including create_alias_by_subscription, create_or_update_alias, create_segment, create_subscription, create_template, create_user, export_audience_activity_csv, export_subscriptions_csv, get_segment, get_template, get_user_identity, and get_user_identity_by_subscription.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OneSignal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to OneSignal in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
OneSignal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OneSignal is developed by OneSignal. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
